thread:
Emma (support): Mike from Acme reported a p99 spike on tool-router function-calls when using structured output + schema validation. p95 stayed ~350ms, p99 jumped from ~900ms to ~2.4s around 02:10 UTC. Repro attached.
Liam (eng-runtime): can you paste the exact request shape, model id, and any error traces?
Emma (support): Using /v1/generate, tool_call enabled, schema validation on. model: redwood/fastfunc-v2, seq_len ~512, batch=1. No auth/billing errors. Stripped request below: 
```json
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood/fastfunc-v2",
  "input": "<user prompt>",
  "tool_call": true,
  "tools": [{
    "name": "lookup",
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": ["id"]
    }
  }]
}
```
Sofia (eng-ml): I pulled traces — schema_validator service shows CPU spikes and occasional GC pauses. Validator RPC p99 adds ~1.1s per call when complex schemas are either cold or when we run full "format" and pattern checks in the hotpath.
Raj (eng-infra): any infra changes around 02:00? autoscaler events or deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/fastfunc-v2@rev-2026-03-15-02:05 finished in us-west-2
Liam (eng-runtime): looks correlated with that deploy. Two suspects: (1) we tightened ajv strictness in middleware (format/pattern checks enabled); (2) validator instance count briefly dropped during the deploy -> queueing and head-of-line latency. Need a quick repro to validate.
Emma (support): I reproduced locally with the same payload — p99 ~2.1s. Repro command: 
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
Liam (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: toggle schema-validation into lenient mode for tool_router route (feature flag ff-tool-validate=lenient). Sofia, can you prepare a patch to short-circuit deep format/pattern checks and add a permissive fast-path cache?
Sofia (eng-ml): On it. Short-term: skip `format` and `pattern` checks, add a fast-path schema cache keyed by schemaHash+modelVersion, and emit validation timing metrics. Will open PR scoped to middleware so we can revert fast.
Raj (eng-infra): I'll pin validator ASG min instances to 3 and bump CPU requests for validator pods to reduce contention during rollouts.
Liam (eng-runtime): Owners: Sofia (patch), Raj (infra pin + rollback), Emma (customer comms). ETA: 2 hours for hotfix canary, 24h monitor window. Please attach reproduction payload to INS ticket.
Mike (customer): Thanks — we observed the drop after 02:10. Temporary lenient validation is fine for us. Please keep us posted.
Emma (support): Filed INS-2026-09 with logs, traces, and the reproducer. Will update customer after hotfix.
Liam (eng-runtime): Follow-ups (long-term): (a) move heavy schema checks to an async validator pipeline, (b) introduce an in-proc fast-validator for short-circuited checks with bounded CPU, (c) improve schema cache eviction (LRU by hash), (d) add per-route p99 dashboards.
Sofia (eng-ml): PR notes: ajv options {strict:false, validateFormats:false} + microcache keyed by schemaHash. Telemetry: validation.time_ms and schema.cache.hit/miss.
Raj (eng-infra): Keeping autoscaler conservative until we verify. Rolling the patch to prod now.
deploy-bot: canary rollout of feature-flag ff-tool-validate=lenient -> 10% started
Liam (eng-runtime): Canary metrics: p99 dropping to ~950ms in canary traffic (still above baseline but significantly improved). Continuing rollout and monitoring.
Emma (support): Customer confirmed improved behavior on canary traffic. Will keep ticket open for 24h stable window then close.
